rationale: The target and SG-3 require characterising braking behavior itself to evaluate prevention of unintended braking. H-3 establishes the operating context and braking without an obstacle ahead as the hazardous event; FR-7 supports the relationship between obstacle avoidance and intended braking. P remains focused on braking occurrence and its relationship to obstacles, without incorporating sensing, computation, communication, failure-mitigation mechanisms, or their timing constraints.
determining_elements: Vehicle braking behavior is the phenomenon directly required by the target, rather than merely a mechanism affecting its evaluation.
The straight-ahead urban driving context at 50 km/h, in good weather and without visible obstacles or vehicles ahead, matches H-3.
The scope includes whether braking occurs and whether it is triggered by obstacles or vehicles ahead, supported by H-3 and FR-7.
The declared scope does not extend into obstacle-detection implementation, controller behavior, warnings, redundancy, or mechanism-specific timing.
